notes_for_editor: Thin record: the tnlandforms list is the only source that places a tower here, and the story sits near the 120-word floor. Two searches and several page reads found no source about a lookout in Banks County. The list's number (910) has no column label; it is read as feet, which matches the record's 277.4 m. A search summary mentioned a TowerDex owner page for the Banks County Commission listing an active structure in Homer about 91 m tall, with no stated purpose; TowerDex refuses fetches (403), so it is unread and unused, and it may be a modern structure. The Georgia Forestry Commission county contact page says Banks County has no GFC office and is served from Lula in Hall County; not used. Identity and location of the point (in town or outlying) are unknown.
